text_block_list.text:
Running into the waiting room to celebrate 
T.M. Opera O's victory—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...The crowd rejoices, sending forth 
cheers. ...A graceful, unyielding 
incarnation of brilliant radiance—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: To the proud and noble T.M. Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Come now! Praise the 
triumphant return of today's star!
choice_data_list:
As expected of the "Supreme Overlord" 
Opera O!
This victory should just be the prologue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I have received your praise, loud 
and clear. Now, allow me to send a 
compliment right back to you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I predict it now! You will shower me with 
the exact same praise after the next race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How do I know, you ask? My victory is 
foreseen by all creation, and...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Because it's what you wish for!

And so, TM Opera O was already confident 
in her next victory...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just as my beauty shall endure for all 
eternity, my triumphant march shall never 
cease.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Until the day I become the "End-of-Century 
Overlord" and illuminate the entire world 
with happiness!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However... to think you would comprehend 
this "Supreme Sovereign Philosophy." As 
expected of my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let me ask you this: What should we do 
next?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Then let us apply ourselves at 
once! To obtain that peerless radiance 
which illuminates the heavens!

Seeking further victories... on a later 
day— she devoted herself to training under 
the shining sun!
